purpose: Teach: 乗務/境遇/エキスパート/未経験/県議会/等級/書名/修得

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、乗務員のような現場社員を大事にされた
lines.en: Father treated the frontline staff — drivers, station workers — with real care from the very beginning.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. Slow opening. The voice of someone remembering with clarity and warmth. Slight pause before naming the specifics, as if seeing the scene again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の境遇に細やかに配慮された
lines.en: Yes. He was genuinely attentive to how his employees were doing — their circumstances, their lives.
lines.style: Measured, steady. Speaking as a son who understands what he witnessed. Not performing reverence — stating fact with quiet appreciation. Even pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界のエキスパートと交流されたぞ
lines.en: He built real friendships with the experts in the industry — people others wouldn't have thought to know.
lines.style: Wistful, slightly wondering. Voice softens on 'friendships.' As if still surprised by the reach of his father's curiosity. Slower tempo.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは未経験者にも積極的に道を開かれた
lines.en: Yes. He actively opened doors for people who had no experience — genuinely giving them a chance.
lines.style: Reflective, warm undertone. Emphasis gentle on 'actively' and 'chance.' Speaking from observation, not ideology. Calm, deliberate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、県議会の議員にも理解を求められたぞ
lines.en: He even approached the prefectural assembly members — asked for their understanding and support.
lines.style: Wondering, almost admiring the audacity quietly. 'Approached' lands with slight weight. Voice carries both the boldness and the humility of the act.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の等級分けに公平でいらした
lines.en: Yes. He was scrupulously fair in how he graded and sorted the products — never played favorites.
lines.style: Steady, precise. 'Scrupulously fair' lands with quiet firmness. The voice of someone who saw integrity in action. No flourish — just honest assessment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、書名にこだわって出版された
lines.en: He cared deeply about the title of his publications — every word mattered to him.
lines.style: Wistful, almost fond. Slight smile in the voice at the memory of his fastidiousness. Slower, more meditative pace. Trailing off slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員が技術を修得するまで根気強く待たれた
lines.en: Yes. He waited patiently — really patiently — for his staff to master their skills. He never rushed them.
lines.style: Warm, calm close. Emphasis on 'patiently' — twice, to let it sink. The voice of someone who saw this patience model something. Gentle fade at the end.
